descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.
We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to lead the end-to-end development of our data platform, drive the design of scalable cloud-native architectures, and mentor engineers while fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
 We’re launching a Double Referral Bonus Campaign for this role in EPAM Romania open positions, covering candidates referred and hired between September 7th, 2026 and December 31st, 2026. The campaign applies to A3+ roles, for both B2B and permanent positions, across all skills and technologies.
 Responsibilities
Develop our data platform built on Databricks & Kubernetes from end to end
Integrate new data sources such as test automation results, deployments, and vulnerabilities
Utilize data sources to build accurate and reliable metrics through automated processes
Contribute to the design and implementation of a scalable data platform architecture on Azure
Participate in the larger enablement community and help improve processes every day
Apply an "open-source and build yourself" mentality within a corporate environment through innersourcing
Architect and implement CI/CD pipelines, robust scrapers, automation scripts, and Infrastructure as Code templates to streamline deployment processes
Optimize performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency of data pipelines and analytics workloads
Coach and mentor engineers to foster technical excellence, code quality, and knowledge sharing
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Requirements
3+ years of relevant professional experience in data engineering, data warehousing, and software development, preferably in large-scale or complex environments
Understanding of modern data architectures and the ability to design scalable, maintainable, and future-proof solutions aligned with business goals
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, particularly Azure, including designing and deploying cloud-native data solutions
Proficiency in DBT, Python, and Terraform
Proficiency in GitHub Actions, Databricks, and Go
Skills in SQL and the ability to select and advocate for the right tools for the job
Expertise in optimizing performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency of data pipelines and analytics workloads
Experience architecting CI/CD pipelines, robust scrapers, automation scripts, and Infrastructure as Code templates
Passion for navigating and thriving in complex, ambiguous environments with a proactive approach to problem-solving
Strong architectural vision and the ability to contribute to the technical roadmap
Proven track record of coaching and mentoring engineers
Excellent communication skills to translate technical concepts for varied audiences
 We offer
Full access to cutting-edge tools and technologies
Competitive compensation depending on experience and skills
All-around Social package: professional & soft skills training, medical & family care programs, sports
Free English classes
Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
Continuous experience exchange with experts and professionals worldwide
Friendly team and comfortable working environment
Engineering, corporate, and social events within and outside the Company
Flexible working schedule
Opportunities for self-realization
